title: More ways to make images
summary:
Six community projects joined the directory, spanning image-making, WordPress, Flutter, Discord and an LLM podcast.

The project showcase added Elixpo Art, which supports thematic prompts, aspect ratios and reference images, and LAHGen, which generates images in different artistic styles.

The directory added a Gutenberg block that generates images and saves them to the WordPress Media Library, plus a community Flutter/Dart SDK for text, image and audio generation.

AlphaLLM, a conversation-aware Discord bot with image and voice generation, joined the Social Bots list. The Creative Apps list added Podcast #1500, where LLMs discuss topics including vibe coding.
